title: Bangalore to Mysore Road Trip: A Stop Worth Making in Mayaganahalli
description: Driving the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway? Fernway by Stories in Mayaganahalli is an open-air cafe and restaurant stop, open daily 1pm–6am, between Bidadi and Ramanagara.
imageAlt: Fernway by Stories sign in the garden at Mayaganahalli on the Bangalore–Mysore Expressway
keywords: Bangalore Mysore road trip food stop

sections.heading: A real meal, not just a quick break
paragraphs: The Bangalore–Mysore Expressway made the drive faster — and made good places to stop harder to notice. Fernway by Stories, in Mayaganahalli between Bidadi and Ramanagara, is worth slowing down for: an open-air garden cafe and restaurant with space to stretch out.

sections.heading: What you'll find
list: Open every day, {{hoursDisplay}} — lunch, dinner or a late-night stop
North Indian food, global comfort plates, coffee and cold brews
Spacious garden seating for families and groups — pet friendly too
Live music on Friday and Saturday nights
